description: Read one of your Besidka projects: name, instructions, pinned and archived state, knowledge mode, project memory state (enabled, status, account memory, entry count), knowledge totals against the limits and the knowledge items (id, kind, title, size, status, flagged, pinned). Use read_project_knowledge_item to read an item. Requires signing in (projects:read).
name: get_project
title: Read a project
